descr: The new pre‑release lets Datasette configure any OpenAI‑compatible model, including local instances via LM Studio, Ollama or llama.cpp.
paragrafi: Simon Willison announced the 0.1a11 release of the datasette-llm plugin on 14 November 2026.
The update introduces direct configuration of OpenAI‑compatible endpoints, removing the need for extra LLM plugins.
Users can point Datasette at local models such as lmstudio-qwen (qwen3.8‑27b) running on http://localhost:1234/v1.
The release also adds faster model lookup, support for tools and streaming, and refined handling of credentials and allowlists.
Compatibility requires LLM 0.37.1 or newer, and the plugin now raises clearer errors for missing keys or unknown models.
perche: This change makes it easier for developers to run private or locally hosted models with Datasette, supporting free and open‑source alternatives.
